meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Billowing Waves
meta.description: Breaking waves crash ashore as the tides surge forward.

units.rawText:
Careful, Sol, the <color=orange>waves</color> are coming!
The wave activity here is very heavy. One comes every six seconds, and it'll sweep us to the other side and disorient us.
